name: MPAY
recent: ManagePay 正在推进最多 10% 的私募新股计划，并已向 Bursa Securities 申请将实施期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 6 月 9 日。公司将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第 16 届常年股东大会，同时提呈更新关联方交易授权等议案。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比与同比均增长，但仍录得净亏损。
notable: 并已申请将实施期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 6 月 9 日。
将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第 16 届常年股东大会。
risks: 私募新股最多占已发行股份 10%，若完成将导致现有股东持股比例被摊薄。
集团董事经理兼集团首席执行官 Dato' Chew Chee Seng 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日涉及 900 万股（0.872%）的股份转让（由配偶转出）。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 7,375,000 令吉，环比增长 194.8%，同比增长 56.3%；净亏损为 4,603,000 令吉，净利率为 -62.4%，较上一季度的 -102.9% 有所收窄。

recent_en: ManagePay is pursuing a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares and has applied to Bursa Securities for a 6-month extension to complete it by 9 June 2027. Revenue for the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026 rose both QoQ and YoY, but the company remained in net loss.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares, with a 6-month extension sought to complete by 9 June 2027.
16th Annual General Meeting scheduled for 27 November 2026.
EGM held on 28 August 2026 approved the proposed issuance of shares and proposed share capital reduction.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% of issued shares would dilute existing shareholders if completed.
Group Managing Director/Group CEO Dato' Chew Chee Seng was involved in a transfer of 9,000,000 shares (0.872%) on 1 October 2026 (transferred from spouse).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 7,375,000, up 194.8% QoQ and 56.3% YoY; net loss was MYR 4,603,000 with a net margin of -62.4%, compared with -102.9% in the previous quarter.
